card.label: Card
card.blurb: What a card IS — its school, form and feel. Carried by cards, by the classes that lean on them, and by the equipment that rewrites them.

creature.label: Creature
creature.blurb: What a creature IS. Gates proc resistance, and the one domain the engine reads at runtime.

item.label: Item
item.blurb: What a piece of gear DOES beyond its numbers, and what a run pickup is.

run.label: Run
run.blurb: Run structure — what an event, an encounter or an unlock is about.

itemType.label: Item type
itemType.blurb: What a piece of equipment IS, as the Armoury and the smith name it. Distinct from the card domain: a Blade item type and a Blade card school are different facts about the same sword.

grantSource.label: Grant source
grantSource.blurb: Where a starting card came from. The composed deck deals bound cards in this vocabulary's authored order, so adding a source is a row here rather than a code change. Nothing WEARS these — the `grant` family exists to declare them, the way `effect` declares which words a damage effect may carry.

presentation.label: Combat presentation
presentation.blurb: Sprite selection only; never damage or resistance identity.

attackSource.label: Attack source
attackSource.blurb: Source profile supplying an attack; separate from damage type.

delivery.label: Delivery
delivery.blurb: How a direct attack reaches its targets.

damageType.label: Damage type
damageType.blurb: Identity of a typed HP damage component.

theme.label: Theme
theme.blurb: Build synergies; tags alone grant no effects.

property.label: Property
property.blurb: What a holder CONFERS while it is held. Each property node has exactly one entry in nodeEffects.json; the holder grants it, and it leaves when the holder does. EVERY family may carry one — what the mount path can hold (worn, owned, chosen) is the engine's narrower list, engine/properties.js MOUNTABLE_KINDS.

blade.label: Blade
blade.blurb: Steel and edge — direct weapon work.

bow.label: Bow

blood.label: Blood

heavy.label: Heavy

damage:earth.label: Earth
damage:earth.blurb: Applies 1 Slowed on a Health hit unless the card already prints a Slowed effect. Not reduced by armour class; absorbed by Ward.

ability:last-stand.blurb: Tests whether current HP is at or below 50% of current maximum HP before resolution.

ability:war-tempo.label: War Tempo
ability:war-tempo.blurb: Tests whether at least two Heavy cards have already been played by the acting player during this turn.

ability:wide-cleave.label: Wide Cleave

ability:ember-crown.label: Ember Crown
ability:ember-crown.blurb: Marks a one-charge bonus to the next direct attack this turn; the charge expires at turn end and cannot stack with itself.

ability:dreadweight.label: Dreadweight
ability:dreadweight.blurb: Tests whether the selected enemy is currently Staggered before a direct hit.

ability:oathscar.label: Oathscar
ability:oathscar.blurb: Identifies the first Guard card after the acting player has lost HP since their previous turn began; at most once per turn.

ability:wound-harvest.label: Wound Harvest
ability:wound-harvest.blurb: Identifies a credited kill of an enemy that had positive Bleed buildup immediately before the killing hit.

ability:cinder-orbit.label: Cinder Orbit
ability:cinder-orbit.blurb: Tests whether the immediately preceding card played this turn by the same player was a spell.

ability:lunar-guard.label: Lunar Guard
ability:lunar-guard.blurb: Tests whether the acting player has already spent at least 2 Mana this turn; refunded Mana does not erase spending.

ability:comet-mark.label: Comet Mark
ability:comet-mark.blurb: Marks an attack that applies an authored Vulnerable rider after its direct damage.

ability:rime-mirror.label: Rime Mirror
ability:rime-mirror.blurb: Marks a defensive spell with an authored Frost buildup rider against one selected enemy.

ability:constellation.label: Constellation
ability:constellation.blurb: Tests how many distinct Starstone card IDs the acting player has played this turn; two copies of one ID count once.

ability:mana-weave.label: Mana Weave
ability:mana-weave.blurb: Marks an authored Mana restoration rider, capped at one activation per owning player per turn.

ability:gravity-snare.label: Gravity Snare
ability:gravity-snare.blurb: Marks a spell with an authored Weak rider after its direct damage.

ability:nightglass.label: Nightglass
ability:nightglass.blurb: Marks a one-charge direct-spell-damage bonus to the next spell this turn; no stacking and no carry into the next turn.

ability:eclipse-window.label: Eclipse Window
ability:eclipse-window.blurb: Tests whether the selected enemy has positive Frost buildup or is Frost-exposed before resolution.

ability:warded-casting.label: Warded Casting
ability:warded-casting.blurb: Marks a one-charge Mana discount for the next spell this turn; cost cannot fall below zero and the charge expires at turn end.

ability:celestial-echo.label: Celestial Echo
ability:celestial-echo.blurb: Identifies the second play of the same Starstone card ID in a turn; the condition can activate once per turn.

ability:cold-memory.label: Cold Memory
ability:cold-memory.blurb: Marks an authored amount of Block retained into the next turn; retention sources use the largest allowance, not their sum.

ability:astral-convergence.label: Astral Convergence
ability:astral-convergence.blurb: Identifies the third distinct Starstone card ID played by the same player in a turn; once per turn.

ability:ash-opener.label: Ash Opener
ability:ash-opener.blurb: Tests whether this is the acting player's first card played this turn.

ability:discard-weave.label: Discard Weave
ability:discard-weave.blurb: Tests whether the acting player has discarded a card this turn; Exhaust and a spent card entering discard do not count.

ability:crooked-guard.label: Crooked Guard
ability:crooked-guard.blurb: Marks a direct attack with an authored Weak rider; the rider resolves after damage.

ability:exposed-flank.label: Exposed Flank
ability:exposed-flank.blurb: Tests whether the selected enemy has exactly zero Block immediately before the hit.

ability:sleight-hand.label: Sleight of Hand
ability:sleight-hand.blurb: Marks an authored draw-then-discard sequence; the player chooses the discarded card and ordinary hand limits apply.

ability:tether-cut.label: Tether Cut
ability:tether-cut.blurb: Tests whether the selected enemy currently has Weak or Vulnerable before damage resolves.

ability:smoke-edge.label: Smoke Edge
ability:smoke-edge.blurb: Marks a one-charge bonus to the next Blade attack this turn; the charge expires at turn end and cannot stack with itself.

ability:carrion-finish.label: Carrion Finish
ability:carrion-finish.blurb: Tests whether the selected enemy is at or below 50% maximum HP before the attack.

ability:paired-strikes.label: Paired Strikes
ability:paired-strikes.blurb: Marks an attack with exactly two authored direct hits; rank bonuses are divided across the hits.

ability:trapdoor.label: Trapdoor
ability:trapdoor.blurb: Tests whether the acting player has already played at least one Guile card and one Guard card this turn.

ability:clean-escape.label: Clean Escape
ability:clean-escape.blurb: Identifies the first Guard card played before any attack this turn; once per turn.

ability:razor-debt.label: Razor Debt
ability:razor-debt.blurb: Identifies the first Blade attack after an explicit discard this turn; once per turn.

ability:mercy-ash.label: Mercy in Ash
ability:mercy-ash.blurb: Marks a defensive card with an authored healing rider; healing cannot exceed maximum HP.

ability:blood-censer.label: Blood Censer
ability:blood-censer.blurb: Marks a card with an explicit HP offering paid before its benefits; the offering cannot reduce HP below 1.

ability:blight-seed.label: Blight Seed
ability:blight-seed.blurb: Marks a direct hit with an authored Crimson Blight buildup rider; this is not Poison.

ability:funeral-guard.label: Funeral Guard

ability:ember-tithe.label: Ember Tithe

ability:requiem-brand.label: Requiem Brand

ability:pilgrim-shelter.label: Pilgrim Shelter

ability:scarred-rite.label: Scarred Rite

ability:dawn-rite.label: Dawn Rite

ability:burden-bearer.label: Burden Bearer

ability:sepulchral-pact.label: Sepulchral Pact
ability:sepulchral-pact.blurb: Identifies a credited kill of an enemy with positive Crimson Blight buildup immediately before the killing hit.

camp.label: Combat camp
camp.blurb: Authored combat identity shared by cards and enemy moves.

maneuver.label: Combat maneuver
maneuver.blurb: Authored combat identity shared by cards and enemy moves.

school.label: Magic school
school.blurb: Authored combat identity shared by cards and enemy moves.

counterMode.label: Counter reach
counterMode.blurb: Authored combat identity shared by cards and enemy moves.

camp:physical.label: Physical
camp:physical.blurb: Selects physical Guard or magical Ward combat rules.

camp:spell.label: Spell
camp:spell.blurb: Selects physical Guard or magical Ward combat rules.

maneuver:attack.label: Attack
maneuver:attack.blurb: Fast strike. Gains extra Poise pressure against a prepared Smash or casting enemy.

maneuver:defend.label: Defend
maneuver:defend.blurb: Prepare defense. Physical cards protect Guard; defensive spell cards protect Ward. Smash breaks physical Guard.

maneuver:counter.label: Counter
maneuver:counter.blurb: Prepare one reaction. Reduce damage from one eligible hit. A fully absorbed eligible hit triggers a stronger reply; Sweep, Force and Piercing bypass melee Counter.

maneuver:sweep.label: Sweep
maneuver:sweep.blurb: Windmill strike. Bypasses melee Counter; physical Guard and ranged attacks answer it.

maneuver:ranged.label: Ranged
maneuver:ranged.blurb: Ranged delivery avoids melee replies. Ranged Counter, spell Counter and defensive Alteration answer it.

maneuver:smash.label: Smash
maneuver:smash.blurb: Heavy strike. Deals extra damage against physical Guard and extra Poise damage when Guard breaks. Fast Attack and Counter answer it.

school:frost.label: Frost
school:frost.blurb: Cold control: Frost buildup rewards follow-up attacks and constrains enemy tempo.

school:fire.label: Fire
school:fire.blurb: Fire pressure: Burn buildup keeps pressure between turns.

school:lightning.label: Lightning
school:lightning.blurb: Lightning disruption: Sap weakens direct attacks and enables spell follow-ups.

school:force.label: Force
school:force.blurb: Force pressure: strip Ward and bypass melee Counter.

school:alteration.label: Alteration
school:alteration.blurb: Defensive and shaping magic: Ward, resource shaping and control. Answers ranged pressure.

school:illusion.label: Illusion
school:illusion.blurb: Tempo and hand control: Weak, confusion, draw and energy tools.

school:divine.label: Divine
school:divine.blurb: Restoration and cleansing: heal, protect and remove hostile effects.

school:decay.label: Decay
school:decay.blurb: Attrition and offerings: Crimson Blight, life transfer and pay-health combos.

school:earth.label: Earth
school:earth.blurb: Grounding and weight: Slowed and Entombed slow or stop enemy turns; Stoneskin keeps Block.

counter:melee.label: Melee counter
counter:melee.blurb: Replies to eligible melee Attack or Smash. Sweep, Force, Piercing and Ranged bypass this reaction.

counter:ranged.label: Ranged counter
counter:ranged.blurb: Replies only to incoming physical projectiles. Spells and melee moves do not trigger it.

counter:spell.label: Spell counter
counter:spell.blurb: Intercepts incoming physical ranged moves or spells. Against physical ranged moves, strips Ward without Health retaliation. Against spellcasters, can retaliate against Health.

classification.enemyMove.label: enemyMove
classification.enemyMove.blurb: A scoped action in an enemy move table.

maneuver:casting.label: Spell
maneuver:casting.blurb: A spell stance. Counter coverage depends on school and delivery.

range:melee.label: Melee
range:melee.blurb: At melee range: within arm's length.

range:reach.label: Reach
range:reach.blurb: At reach: past arm's length but not yet ranged.

targeting:area.label: Area
targeting:area.blurb: An area action; most Counters do not cover it.

trait:counterstrike.label: Counterstrike
trait:counterstrike.blurb: +50% effectiveness; +75% when the player's stance has advantage over the target's.

trait:flux.label: Flux
trait:flux.blurb: On hit: N Ward damage, or double the Ward damage the card already deals.

trait:impact.label: Impact
trait:impact.blurb: On hit: N Poise damage, or double the Poise damage the card already deals.

trait:persistent.label: Persistent
trait:persistent.blurb: Granted Precision survives the end of its owner's turn.

trait:reaction.label: Reaction
trait:reaction.blurb: Playable from hand during the opponent's turn, before the pending action resolves.

target.label: Target
target.blurb: An explicitly targeted spell bypasses Evasion without consuming an Evasion stack.

throw.label: Throw
throw.blurb: Choose Throw to attack one band beyond this weapon’s range with reduced Precision. Does not consume the weapon.
